title: Strict-presentation proper derived comparison adapter
statement: For a compactification c of g and its strict etale compact-support system S, at every coefficient level n there exists a natural isomorphism from the strict proper-derived level followed by integral exceptional realization on Y to integral exceptional realization on c.Z followed by the etale derived lower-star functor for c.g.

source.place: node thm-pur-adic-reconstruction, proper derived comparison factor

proof.text: Transport the published proper derived comparison through the equivalence between its semilinear coefficient presentation and the strict coefficient presentation used by S.properDerived.level n. Compose the transported comparison with the presentation isomorphisms; the resulting natural isomorphism has the displayed source and target.

proof_origin.place: The proper comparison factor in the compact-support realization proof.
